metadata.stacks_on: the published spec, or the T-109 candidate (assets/characters/girl_auburn_bun_glasses/spec/candidates/T-109/)
metadata.notes: T-113 candidate (unpublished, evaluation only): closed upper lids follow the eyeball (eyes.lids.closed_fit, face_v3/lids.py fit_closed_lids; no pale dome in Blink/Smile/Laugh/Squint); optional presets listed so the per-character emotions play: SmileOpen (T-109) for girl_delighted. Belongs in assets/characters/girl_auburn_bun_glasses/spec/candidates/T-113/ (outside the T-113 write-set). closed_fit.gaze_range_deg [26, 26]: wider than her 16/8 deg spec range because e908 drives her eyes to 25 deg down / 18-26 deg sideways during a blink (f42); with her own range (or [8, 4]) the iris then showed through the closed lid, more than on the published master (T-113 README). closed_fit.shell_subsurface 0: the upper lid shell (1-2 mm) gets a skin copy without subsurface; with the skin's 1.4 cm subsurface radius the closed lid otherwise shows the white eyeball through it (the pale part of the dome).
